Apple Inc Stock in 2018 Q1 Driven by Institutional Investors
July 15, 2018 - By olga Sentiment for Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL)
Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) institutional sentiment decreased to 0.69 in Q1 2018 . Its down -0.04, from 0.73 in 2017Q4. The ratio is negative, as 770 investment managers started new and increased holdings, while 1108 reduced and sold their holdings in Apple Inc. The investment managers in our partner’s database reported: 2.86 billion shares, down from 2.98 billion shares in 2017Q4. Also, the number of investment managers holding Apple Inc in their top 10 holdings decreased from 948 to 922 for a decrease of 26. Sold All: 69 Reduced: 1039 Increased: 645 New Position: 125.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $940.41 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 18.51 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
The stock increased 0.16% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $191.33. About 12.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since July 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 EPS, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76B for 21.84 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.
Harvard Management Co Inc holds 34.77% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. for 1.69 million shares. Lyons Wealth Management Llc. owns 115,119 shares or 29.35% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Independent Investors Inc has 25.86% invested in the company for 386,568 shares. The Nebraska-based Berkshire Hathaway Inc has invested 21.27% in the stock. Trb Advisors Lp, a New York-based fund reported 50,000 shares.
Since January 1, 0001, it had 0 insider buys, and 12 sales for $49.61 million activity. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Ratings Coverage
Ratings analysis reveals 54% of Apple’s analysts are positive. Out of 35 Wall Street analysts rating Apple, 19 give it “Buy”, 0 “Sell” rating, while 16 recommend “Hold”. The lowest target is $157 while the high is $235. The stock’s average target of $198.46 is 3.73% above today’s ($191.33) share price. AAPL was included in 75 notes of analysts from January 17, 2018. The firm has “Hold” rating by Bernstein given on Friday, February 2. As per Wednesday, May 2, the company rating was maintained by UBS. The rating was initiated by Gabelli on Tuesday, April 3 with “Hold”. The rating was maintained by BTIG Research on Tuesday, February 13 with “Buy”. Barclays Capital maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Friday, March 16. Barclays Capital has “Equal-Weight” rating and $168 target. The rating was maintained by Maxim Group on Friday, February 2 with “Buy”. Bank of America maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Tuesday, April 3 with “Buy” rating. Bank of America maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, January 17 report. The rating was maintained by Oppenheimer with “Hold” on Monday, April 30. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) earned “Hold” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets on Wednesday, May 2.
